        15       Senator.  Let us pray.

        16                  As the Senate convenes to serve our

        17       New York State citizens on this late Olympic

        18       summer day, may we call on You, O God, to

        19       bless these Senate members to prepare for the

        20       cold anticipated weather so that they will

        21       find opportunities for needed affordable heat

        22       for all of our winter season, providing the

        23       homeless and the needy with the necessities of

        24       life.

        21       purpose of considering a complete plan of

        22       legislation to implement budgetary savings;

        24       respect to such other subjects as I may

        25       recommend.
